{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

# AutoDL network proxy
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true

# HF cache on data disk + offline mode
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

cd /root/structfuse
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/m2_pilot_data"
CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints"

echo "=== M2 Pilot Training ==="
echo "Start time: $(date)"
echo "Data dir: $DATA_DIR"

declare -A FILE_MAP
FILE_MAP[random]="train_random.jsonl"
FILE_MAP[embedding_distance]="train_embedding.jsonl"
FILE_MAP[dataflow_aware]="train_dataflow.jsonl"

for STRATEGY in random embedding_distance dataflow_aware; do
    echo ""
    echo "=== Training strategy: ${STRATEGY} (seed=42) ==="
    echo "Start: $(date)"
    
    OUTPUT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/m2_pilot_${STRATEGY}_s42"
    TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/${FILE_MAP[$STRATEGY]}"
    
    python training/train.py \
        --model-name /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B \
        --train-file "${TRAIN_FILE}" \
        --val-file "${DATA_DIR}/val.jsonl" \
        --output-dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
        --hard-negative-strategy "${STRATEGY}" \
        --learning-rate 2e-5 \
        --temperature 0.07 \
        --batch-size 2 \
        --num-epochs 3 \
        --num-negatives 3 \
        --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
        --use-lora \
        --gradient-checkpointing \
        --max-seq-length 1024 \
        --seed 42 \
        --eval-steps 500 \
        --save-steps 1000 \
        --wandb-project structfuse \
        --dataflow-graph-file "${DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
    
    echo "Done: $(date)"
    
    if [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]; then
        for ckpt in "${OUTPUT_DIR}"/checkpoint-*; do
            if [ -d "$ckpt" ] && [ "$ckpt" != "${OUTPUT_DIR}/best_model" ]; then
                echo "Removing intermediate checkpoint: $ckpt"
                rm -rf "$ckpt"
            fi
        done
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "=== All 3 strategies complete ==="
echo "End time: $(date)"
df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
